diagnostic.note: Earlier iterator experiments used the unbatched layout benchmark recorded in their source patches. The original unbatched baseline executable was replaced when batching was introduced; its source and invocation are retained, but its executable hash was not captured. Final baseline and candidate executable hashes are recorded above.

import json, subprocess, statistics, hashlib, datetime
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/tmp/photonic-identity')
source=json.load(open('/tmp/photonic-runtime/final-measurement.json'))
case=[x for x in source if x['round']==0]
record=[]
for iteration in range(3):
 for fixture in case:
  argument=fixture['argument'].copy()
  count=3 if fixture['name']=='export' else 101 if fixture['binary']=='expression' or fixture['binary']=='scope' else 201
  argument[argument.index('--sample')+1]=str(count)
  row={'name':fixture['name'],'binary':fixture['binary'],'argument':argument,'round':iteration}
  for version in (['before','after'] if iteration%2==0 else ['after','before']):
   print('running',iteration,fixture['name'],version,flush=True)
   result=subprocess.run([str(root/version/fixture['binary']),*argument],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
   row[version]=json.loads(result.stdout)
  record.append(row)
  (root/'acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
  def median(version):
   sample=row[version]['measurement']
   return statistics.median(x['execution'] if isinstance(x['execution'],float) else x['execution']['duration'] for x in sample)*1000
  a,b=median('before'),median('after')
  print(iteration,fixture['name'],round(a,4),round(b,4),round(b/a,3),flush=True)

for fixture in [x for x in case if x['name'] in ['ordinary','scope','consumption','wide','export']]:
 row={'name':fixture['name'],'argument':fixture['argument'].copy()}

import datetime

import hashlib
import json
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/tmp/photonic-identity')
workspace = Path('/Users/robertvanderzee/vantle/photonic')
source = root / 'source'

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if path.exists() else None

def difference(destination):
    path = sorted(set(value.relative_to(source) for value in source.rglob('*') if value.is_file()) | set(value.relative_to(destination) for group in ('language', 'benchmark') for value in (destination / group).rglob('*') if value.is_file()))
    patch = []
    identity = {}
    for name in path:
        before, after = source / name, destination / name
        left = before.read_text() if before.exists() else ''
        right = after.read_text() if after.exists() else ''
        if left == right:
            continue
        patch.extend(difflib.unified_diff(left.splitlines(keepends=True), right.splitlines(keepends=True), fromfile='a/' + str(name) if before.exists() else '/dev/null', tofile='b/' + str(name) if after.exists() else '/dev/null'))
        identity[str(name)] = {'before': digest(before), 'after': digest(after)}
    return ''.join(patch), identity

patch, identity = difference(workspace)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='photonic-dependency-') as directory:
    directory = Path(directory)
    for name in identity:
        previous = source / name
        if previous.exists():
            target = directory / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(previous.read_bytes())
    subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', '-'], cwd=directory, input=patch, text=True, check=True)
    for name, value in identity.items():
        assert digest(directory / name) == value['after'], name

    pair = list(zip(row['before']['measurement'], row['after']['measurement']))

allocation = json.loads((root / 'allocation.json').read_text())
for row in allocation:

            assert sample['footprint']['retained'] == 0

assert all(phase['pass'] for row in summary for phase in row['phase'].values())
control = json.loads((root / 'control-summary.json').read_text())
assert all(row['pass'] for row in control)
scaling = json.loads((root / 'scaling-summary.json').read_text())
assert all(row[phase]['pass'] for row in scaling for phase in ('initialization', 'execution'))
for row in json.loads((root / 'scaling.json').read_text()):

assert len(equivalence) == 9 and all(row['equal'] for row in equivalence)

    experiment[name] = {

    }

value = {
    'metadata': {
        'time': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        'platform': platform.platform(),
        'machine': platform.machine(),
        'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=workspace, text=True).strip(),
        'baseline': 'Final incremental capture-dependency implementation recorded in document/dependency.json',
        'binary': {version: {path.name: digest(path) for path in (root / version).iterdir() if path.is_file()} for version in ('before', 'after')},
